name: Jilin Province Huinan Changlong Bio-pharmacy Company Limited
summary: Jilin Province Huinan Changlong Bio-pharmacy Company Limited manufactures and distributes Chinese medicines and pharmaceutical products under the Changlong and Qing Tong brands in the People's Republic of China. The company provides Edaravone injection, compound brain comfort capsules, haikun kidney capsules, cefpirome sulfate for injections, Cefpiramide for injections, anti-bone hyperplasia tablets, Lysine zinc gluconate tablets, and Qianlie Guihuang Tablets. It also engages in the manufacture and distribution of beverages and prepackaged food, as well as health products.
